About us

Vervaunt is an energetic and forward-thinking eCommerce and paid media consultancy, born out of a mutual passion for helping premium brands and ambitious retailers grow online, sustainably.

We work with a portfolio of respected eCommerce businesses and we’re very proud of this, as well as the relationships we retain with these clients and our combined achievements.

---

Brands we have worked with

---



* Astrid & Miyu

  Astrid & Miyu is a contemporary jewellery brand known for its modern and elegant designs. They continue to be a go-to brand for fashionable, timeless and high-quality jewellery pieces.

  Before working with the Vervaunt team, the brand was seeing a decline in conversion rate across paid social, alongside constraints in effectively expanding their paid media efforts. We manage their accounts across the UK, EU and US, and regularly restructure and optimise their accounts as best practices shift and new campaign types are released.

    Increase in new customer revenue
  + 59%

    Increase in revenue from social
  + 34%

    Increase in online sales
  + 3x

    Increase in prospecting ad spend
* PANGAIA

  PANGAIA is a direct-to-consumer material science company with a sustainable mission to save our environment with innovative tech and bio-engineered materials.

  The PANGAIA team approached Vervaunt with ambitions of rapid but sustainable growth. At the time, there was no internal resource in the PANGAIA team and so they needed an agency to help support their paid social strategy and build a structure around their goals.

  Sunspel is a luxury fashion brand with over 160 years of heritage and experience. They are recognised for their quality and style, and are known for their classic t-shirts, featured in magazines and publications such as GQ and Esquire.

  Vervaunt began working with Sunspel in April 2020 across Google Search, Shopping, Facebook and Instagram. They had previously used another paid media agency but they were not seeing results, despite their impressive growth online elsewhere.

  Osprey is a global brand founded in California, creating innovative and quality hiking and trekking backpacks. We manage Osprey's paid social and paid search strategies, with a key focus on localisation and driving the expansion of Osprey’s presence in international markets across France, Germany, Italy, and the UK.

  Sales and revenue have not only surpassed the industry benchmark, but we have achieved this during a period when customer confidence and purchasing power presented significant challenges for other brands.

  Founded in 2013, La Coqueta is a leading designer fashion brand and boutique for babies and children aged 0 months to 10 years. They started working with Vervaunt as the company faced growth challenges, and therefore needed a cohesive strategy, ensuring that their marketing efforts aligned with its wider business goals.   
    
  We manage both eCommerce and paid media efforts, which involves implementing their paid media strategy, business guidance, and actioning all campaign and ad builds.

* The Frankie Shop

  The Frankie Shop is a go-to premium fashion and lifestyle brand specialising in wardrobe basics and tailoring, stocking brands such as GANNI, JW Anderson and A Emery.

  Previously, The Frankie Shop did not work with an agency and so wanted to work with Vervaunt to guide their eCommerce strategy, align technology with their growth aspirations, and boost rapid organic growth, especially on platforms such as Instagram. The performance marketing team manages both paid search and social for the brand, whilst the eCommerce team both governs and consults on the day-to-day delivery of their strategic eCommerce retainer.

Since partnering with Vervaunt in 2022, our performance marketing team has overseen Google and Meta accounts across the US, EU, and EMEA regions, whilst our eCommerce team focus on improving site UX and overall eCommerce presence.

Vervaunt as a B Corp

In July 2024, Vervaunt became a certified B Corp, reflecting our commitment to balancing our focus on people and the planet with profit. B Corp certification holds agencies to high standards of social and environmental responsibility, and for Vervaunt, it formalises values that were always prioritised - putting our team and clients first.  
  
Throughout the certification process, we introduced several key initiatives, including an e-waste disposal policy, sustainable home working practices, and a corporate travel policy aimed at reducing our environmental impact. We’ve also prioritised team well-being with gender pay equity analysis, flu vaccine vouchers, and a breastfeeding-at-work policy.   
  
Being a B Corp is about holding ourselves to higher standards. It means we’re committed to growing responsibly and making a positive impact on our team, clients, and the environment. Looking ahead, we’ll continue these efforts as we work toward recertification in 2027.

* Explore more

# Vervaunt Labs

Vervaunt Labs is our innovation offering, focused on building proprietary technology to improve efficiencies for clients and improve customer experience. Some of the key tools we’ve built include:

* Census - rule-based post purchase questions app for Shopify, primarily used for attribution, first party data capture and on-site feedback.
* Visualise - dynamic creative based on improving image formats for DPAs and DABA, also allows for overlaying key information and attributes.
* Inventory logging and alerts - Automated logging and alerting of inventory change, designed to reduce spend on items with broken stock and help attribute performance shifts.
* Sale alerts - alerts on competitor sale activity, to help manage shifts in spend and attribute performance change on channels like Google Shopping.
* Creative reporting - detailed reporting on key metrics for individual Meta creative.
* Performance monitoring - automated daily logging of client performance, monitoring key speed metrics and scores.
* Benchmarks - internal client benchmarking across paid channels and Google Analytics. Data stored in our data warehouse and segmented by vertical.
